description: Get ready for an evening of unapologetic laughs with Mohd. Suhel Live — a stand-up comedy show where Suhel dives into brutally honest takes on his life, his parents, his brother, and everything that makes family gatherings weirdly funny. From Mumbai versus Delhi banter to dark, deadpan humor and a few jokes that almost got him into trouble, Suhel brings it all with a straight face and razor-sharp timing. It’s a mix of relatable, risky, and ridiculously funny stories that make you laugh, flinch, and nod all at once. description: From balance sheets to punchlines — Banker OP in The House is Piyush Sharma’s hilarious take on life as a banker-turned-comedian. Best known as the witty, straight-faced “Banker OP” , Piyush brings his unique brand of dry humor, corporate commentary, and middle-class madness to the stage. In this one-hour solo special, Piyush dives deep into the absurdity of office culture, growing up in a small town, Indian family quirks, and the existential crisis of working a 9-to-5. Expect razor-sharp observations, awkward silences, and a painfully funny reminder of your own corporate life.
